I can't fully grasp why so many hate on this game- 7 years later, I've finally gotten around to playing it. Having enjoyed all the other Mass Effects, I find myself enjoying this one a lot too.

Sure, there are some parts of the game that aren't great, but they don't ruin it for me. The menu system, clearly designed for consoles, is a bit annoying—why can't I just click on things? It makes the controls more of a hassle than they should be. Maybe there's a mod to fix it. Also, dialogue sometimes gets cut off and jumps to the next line, which can be frustrating. Combat is just combat; I zoomed around and shot stuff. There are times when the spoken dialogue doesn't match what I clicked on, and playing as a privileged character feels off.

But despite these annoyances, it's actually quite fun. I feel like we don't have many RPGs like this anymore. I'm down for more space adventures with friends.

Overall, it's a neat game. I like it.

Mass Effect: Andromeda got a rough start back in 2017, but if you give it another shot, you’ll find a game that’s way better than its first impression. It looks like most bugs were fixed which was a relief. The story of the Ryders exploring a brand-new galaxy is packed with heart and intrigue, and the planets you visit are absolutely stunning—even seven years later. Sure, the animations are still a bit awkward (hello, bobbing heads and wandering eyes), but the combat is a blast, the side quests are rich, and the loyalty missions really shine. If you’re up for some epic sci-fi adventuring, it’s worth jumping back into the Tempest and seeing what you missed.

Why ruin everything good about a series? Below are my top most hated things, but I could probably go on for a while. I found frustrations in virtually every aspect from combat to keybinds to conversations and VO.
-Worst vehicle of the series by SO MUCH during a game that desperately needs a good one
-Terribly unintuitive controls that have you sifting thru *menu folders* ?! for a majority of the game just finding what was previously 1 click away
-A combat redesign that, combined with the loss of any pause/time-dilation mechanics makes everything feel immortal while I miss every ability and feel like paper, despite running the same difficulty (HC) to past games. Why am I emptying ENTIRE pistol clips into the literal most basic enemies skull and still only doing like half their health bar?


This game was unrecognizable from the trilogy which I just played thru for the first time, and bad enough to merit my first ever review to beware if you think it will be even close.
